transcript: Join me at the theater today I'm seeing Vladimir, a brand new play at Manhattan Theatre Club. M T C. Has produced some of my favorite shows I've seen over the last few years, so when I was invited to check out Vladimir, I was really excited, especially because it starred Norbert Leo Butz, who was one of my favorite performers of all time. Vladimir is the story of journalists in Russia. While Vladimir Putin never appears in the play, his presence is felt the entire time. It's about the importance of truth and the bravery to fight for a better country, even when all hope feels lost. I love the performances and the show just feels so timely. This is one of my favorite parts of MTC is their shows always feel relevant. After the show, there was even a talk back, and I loved hearing from the cast and creative team. If you want to see Vladimir for yourself, you can get tickets on Todaytix, my favorite app. They even have a rush for $43.
